# Optional task note

Use only when the issue/current-work note does not already answer these questions. Do not create a duplicate packet.

## Outcome
What should the user be able to do?

## Important decisions and boundaries
Only choices that affect behavior, ownership, data safety or compatibility. Leave private implementation choices open.

## Verification
What observable result would establish success? Which concrete failure needs a regression test?

## Starting points
Relevant code/design references and any real unresolved prerequisite.
